scientific_integrity: The positive-offset Markov-gated Brownian renewal model is taken from the cited source; the derived count transform, scaling law and initial-gate-dependent first-translocation tails are restricted to that exact model. No independent priority certificate is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Finite positive excursion offset, one exogenous Markov two-state gate, unbiased Brownian motion and no bulk resetting. Zero-offset and simultaneous parameter limits excluded.
title: Half-normal crossing counts and exact first-translocation tails at a Markov-gated Brownian interface
